opening.argument: The speaker promotes a Forsage plan by assuring viewers they will definitely avoid losses while tying income to a 200 TRX joining contribution, personal activity, and a downline. He explains that placing another participant generates a further 100 TRX entry and presents returns ranging from 1,400 to 200 TRX, alongside potentially unlimited 100% shares. The structure therefore centers earnings on recruitment and tiered participation, while the branching Forsage plan is visibly illustrated. Viewers who have not joined are then directed to a WhatsApp group for further guidance. These are strong promotional claims about how money is committed and earned, although the available evidence does not establish actual payouts, losses, destination behavior, or the accuracy of the stated figures.
